purpose: Capacity-corrected, offline canonical research receipt. This file does not authorize inference, exchange access, or a live-stack change.

frozen_stack.router: P8U top-50% timestamp-local identity gate; numeric score has no downstream feature authority

evaluation.canonical_control: dual MC1 >= 50 bps; maximum two new entries per timestamp
evaluation.capacity_semantics: 80% wallet cap on committed initial margin at entry; marked exposure after price movement is diagnostic only

required_before_promotion: build hash-bound inference bundle including all models, score references, maps, and feature state
